:::{#rem-zero-vector-identity}
#### The zero vector is the additive identity

Adding the zero vector to a vector leaves it unchanged
(@def-vector-addition):
$\vx + \vzero = \vx$ for any vector $\vx$ of the same length,
so $\vzero$ is the [identity element](algebra.qmd#def-identity-element) for vector addition.
For example,

$$
\begin{aligned}
(2, -1) + (0, 0) &= (2 + 0, -1 + 0) \\
&= (2, -1).
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
